title: Ling Yuan Awakens · Secretly Observing
next_chapter_hook: Just as Ling Yuan withdrew his divine sense, his fingers suddenly trembled—a tremor from the depths of his bloodline, as if some long-sealed memory was stirring back to life.

text.content:
Deep within the Tianqing Sect lies the Forbidden Grounds' abyss.

There is no sun or moon here, no wind, only endless darkness interweaving with rotting spiritual energy into absolute silence. In a stone coffin sealed by ten thousand zhang of black ice, a withered, skeletal figure suddenly opened its eyes—cold light shooting from those pupils, causing fine cracks to appear on the surrounding ice walls.

Ling Yuan.

This former Tianqing Sect Elder, who once dominated the martial world, had slept in that stone coffin for a full forty-seven years. His skin had long lost the color of the living, leaving only a layer of dried human skin clinging to his bones, making him look like a living corpse crawled from a grave.

Yet within this frame that seemed ready to fall apart at any moment lay a terrifying pressure. Ling Yuan slowly raised his hand, gazing at his withered fingertips, the corner of his lips curving into a smile uglier than crying.

"Forty-seven years... Hmph, Chen Xuan, you died cleanly."

His voice was hoarse and icy cold, like a whisper from the Nine Nether Hells. Each word that fell caused another layer of the seal on the stone coffin to dim, as if even the laws of heaven and earth trembled beneath his resentment.

Ling Yuan closed his eyes, his divine sense spreading like a tide across the entire Tianqing Sect. His perception pierced through layers of barriers, passed over the dilapidated wooden huts of Outer Disciples/Servants, brushed by the Inner Disciples' meditation chambers, and finally stopped at the newly opened secret realm entrance.

"Found it..."

A hint of amusement curled at the corner of his mouth. That waste servant's aura was resonating subtly with the barrier he had left behind in the secret realm—this was a hidden stake he had personally set up four hundred years ago, specifically to monitor the movements of the Tianji Record.

"Interesting, a Qi Refining Third Layer waste actually triggered the seal I set?"

Ling Yuan's divine sense transformed into an invisible thread, quietly probing into the secret realm along that thread of resonance. The scene within the stone gate gradually became clear in his mind—chaotic spiritual energy, collapsed formations, and that youth standing before the altar, every inch of him screaming 'I am a waste.'

Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
"Waste?"

Ling Yuan laughed silently in the void, that laughter carrying over forty years of accumulated resentment and unwillingness, "The standard for the Tianji Record's selection has never been bone structure or talent. What it seeks is—fate."

text.content:
He remembered that rainy night four hundred years ago.

Back then, he too had been a promising Chief Disciple of the Tianqing Sect, just one step away from the position of Sect Master. Yet the Tianji Record Fragment had chosen that waste named Chen Xuan, not him—the perfect heir with excellent bone structure.

He fell from the clouds to dust, watching helplessly as Chen Xuan rose step by step toward the pinnacle, eventually ascending and leaving this book that could change destiny within the sect.

And he could only grow old slowly in endless resentment.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's divine sense repeatedly examined Chen Ji, finally locking onto the faint strange fluctuation within his body. How should he dispose of this 'waste' who had unexpectedly obtained the Tianji Record?

choices.description: Strike before Chen Ji has grown, directly annihilate the soul within this body using divine sense, and reclaim the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Large Amount of Residual Soul Power
choices.visible_reward: Immediately Obtain the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.risk_hint: Unknown Formations Exist Within the Secret Realm; Forceful Action May Alert Sect Elders
choices.process_label: 凌渊正在凝聚神识之力……

text.content:
Ling Yuan's divine sense transformed into an invisible blade, about to pierce Chen Ji's Mental Sea—however, the instant he struck, a strange fluctuation suddenly surged from the depths of the altar, forcefully rebounding his divine sense.

"This is..."

His pupils contracted sharply. The aura contained within that fluctuation was actually identical to the Dao Charm left behind when Chen Xuan ascended four hundred years ago!

choices.description: Chen Ji is merely a chess piece; the real chess player may not yet have revealed themselves. Striking now would only alert the enemy. Better to use a knife to kill.
choices.visible_cost: Give Chen Ji Time to Grow
choices.visible_reward: Obtain More Intelligence on the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji's Growth Rate May Exceed Expectations

text.content:
Ling Yuan withdrew his gathered divine sense, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

"No rush... Let me好好see what waves this waste can actually make."

He sat cross-legged in the stone coffin, beginning to observe Chen Ji's every move through secret methods.

choices.description: Set a hidden hand before Chen Ji leaves the secret realm, making him unknowingly become your chess piece, ready to be harvested at any moment.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a Dark Chess Piece Usable at Any Time
choices.risk_hint: If Discovered, May Expose One's Own Location

text.content:
Ling Yuan's fingertip flicked lightly, and an undetectable barrier by ordinary people quietly entered Chen Ji's body, like a lurking venomous snake, waiting only for his command to act.

"Go, test what exactly is hidden in this secret realm for me."

Just as Ling Yuan contemplated, Chen Ji on the altar suddenly raised his head, his gaze actually staring directly at the void—as if piercing through layers of barriers, meeting his divine sense eye to eye.

In that instant, Ling Yuan's heart contracted violently.

Not because Chen Ji's gaze was particularly sharp, but because of the tranquility and ease revealed in those eyes—that was not a gaze a Qi Refining Third Layer waste should possess; that was the calm composure only a chess player who had already grasped everything would have.

"Interesting..."

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, a playful smile appearing on his withered face. This 'waste's' acting was quite good; had he not witnessed it personally, he would never have guessed what ambition and calculation lay hidden within this seemingly ordinary body.

He suddenly remembered something, his divine sense stirring slightly as he cast his gaze toward the hazy light shadow at the center of the altar—that was the sign of the Tianji Record's Third Page awakening, yet it was being forcibly suppressed by some mysterious force.

That suppressing force was ice-cold and familiar.

"This aura..."

Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply. His divine sense surged madly toward that mass of light, trying to discern where that familiar fluctuation originated. However, just as he was about to touch the truth, a vast pressure erupted violently from the depths of the light shadow, ruthlessly repelling his divine sense.

"Mmph—"

Ling Yuan groaned, black blood seeping from his seven orifices. The power contained within that pressure was far more terrifying than he had imagined—that was not a realm mortals could touch; that was... the Heavenly Dao Laws themselves!

dialogue.content:
"Heavenly Dao's Eye..."

Ling Yuan murmured to himself, his voice actually carrying a tremor. When Chen Xuan ascended four hundred years ago, he had faintly sensed the existence of this power—the will above all, the existence even immortals must bow to.

"So that's how it is... So that's how it is!"

He suddenly burst into laughter, the sound mad and bitter, echoing in the endless darkness.

text.content:
The laughter stopped abruptly.

Ling Yuan's gaze became unprecedentedly clear, that clarity after being cleansed by truth. He finally understood—the Tianji Record was never any sacred treasure; it was a chess piece placed by the will of the Heavenly Dao in the mortal world, and all past inheritors including himself were merely pitiful insects in this chess game.

But now, things were different.

He had found another chess piece chosen by the Tianji Record—Chen Ji. And within this chess piece seemed to flow a bloodline that even made him feel a palpitating sensation.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan sensed the hidden power within Chen Ji's bloodline, that power actually bearing some similarity to his own origin. How should he utilize this discovery?

choices.description: Release a thread of his own bloodline power, see if Chen Ji's body would produce an instinctive reaction, thereby confirming whether the two shared a blood relationship.

text.content:
A wisp of pale golden bloodline energy escaped from Ling Yuan's fingertip, crossing the void to reach the secret realm. When that thread of energy touched Chen Ji's body, his body actually trembled uncontrollably—as if some dormant instinct was awakening.

Ling Yuan's pupils contracted violently: "This bloodline reaction... Impossible!"

choices.description: Since discovering Chen Ji's extraordinary bloodline, one must act even more carefully. First investigate his family background, then decide whether to recruit or destroy.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji May Discover Someone is Watching

text.content:
Ling Yuan withdrew his divine sense, falling into contemplation. What secret was hidden in this waste servant's bloodline? He needed to consult sect records and trace Chen Ji's family origins.

"Chen Ji... Chen..."

A long-sealed thought emerged in his mind. Four hundred years ago, Chen Xuan also seemed to have been an abandoned infant from some small town under the Tianqing Sect's jurisdiction—and the name of that very town was precisely 'Chen.'

Ling Yuan closed his eyes, beginning to flip through that long-sealed memory in his Mental Sea.

Four hundred years ago, when Chen Xuan had just obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he had also secretly investigated the other's origins. That youth who claimed to be an abandoned infant always possessed an indescribable aura—as if he had long seen through everything in the world, yet also as if deliberately hiding something.

And now, the 'abandoned infant' of yesteryear had already ascended to become an immortal, and the Tianji Record left behind had chosen another youth surnamed 'Chen.'

Was this merely coincidence?

Just then, Chen Ji on the secret realm altar suddenly swayed, the spiritual power fluctuation within his body becoming chaotic. Ling Yuan frowned slightly—was this the Tianji Record rebounding against its user?

He clearly saw threads of fortune, barely visible to the naked eye, being drawn from within Chen Ji's body, turning into dots of starlight that merged into that ancient, simple scroll.

"Heavenly Fate Value..."

Ling Yuan murmured to himself, a flash of understanding crossing his eyes. The Tianji Record's power was not inexhaustible; every glimpse of heavenly secrets required a price—and that price was the user's fortune and lifespan.

"Did Chen Xuan also pay the same price when he ascended?"

Ling Yuan's thoughts drifted into the distance. He suddenly realized a problem—with the Tianji Record's degree of rebound, Chen Ji's mere Qi Refining Third Layer cultivation could not sustain more than a few prophecies before exhausting himself. Unless...

Unless he had found some special cultivation method, or some expert was secretly assisting him.

His gaze fell again on that faintly visible residual soul beside Chen Ji. That residual soul's aura was extremely faint, but the Dao Charm contained within was enough to make even him feel a palpitating sensation.

"Mo Xiansheng..."

Ling Yuan recognized that residual soul's identity. Four hundred years ago, it was precisely this mysterious Mo Xiansheng who had handed the Tianji Record Fragment to Chen Xuan, then disappeared without a trace. Everyone thought he had perished, never expecting him to actually reside within the book pages in residual soul form.

"Interesting... Interesting..."

Ling Yuan clapped lightly, laughter emanating, yet revealing an inexplicable coldness. This chess game was far more complex than he had imagined—Chen Xuan, Mo Xiansheng, the Tianji Record, the Heavenly Dao's Eye... everyone was playing their own chess, and he, Ling Yuan, would never be content to be someone else's chess piece.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji..."

Ling Yuan's voice was low and hoarse, like reciting a cursed name, "Are you a chess piece left behind by Chen Xuan, or an abandoned piece arranged by the Heavenly Dao? In any case, I will personally uncover this answer."

A meaningful smile curved at the corner of his mouth, "I only hope that when you discover your true identity... you can still maintain today's composed demeanor."

text.content:
Ling Yuan withdrew his divine sense, lying back in the stone coffin.

His plan was simple—watch quietly, bide his time. Chen Ji's growth rate was indeed astonishing, but faced with absolute strength, any schemes and intrigues were futile. As long as he lived one more day, the Tianqing Sect would forever be under his control.

As for that waste servant...

"Let you live a few more days."

Ling Yuan slowly closed his eyes, a playful smile appearing on his withered face. In the darkness, his laughter grew increasingly eerie, like demons from the depths of hell whispering.

Just as Ling Yuan was about to fall into slumber, a tremor from the depths of his bloodline suddenly surged to his heart. That feeling was both extremely familiar and extremely unfamiliar, as if some dormant instinct was awakening.

His fingers trembled uncontrollably.

Ling Yuan's eyes snapped open, his withered face showing a shaken expression for the first time. He lowered his head to look at his chest, where something was beating violently—that was a bond surpassing soul and flesh, a brand engraved in bloodline inheritance.

"This feeling..."

His pupils contracted sharply, "Could it be that this Chen Ji boy, and I truly..."

Before the words finished, his fingers suddenly trembled—that was a tremor from the depths of his bloodline, as if some long-sealed memory was stirring back to life. He slowly raised his head, gazing toward the direction of the secret realm, a meaningful smile appearing on his withered face.

"Chen Ji... Interesting, truly interesting..."
